Mobile dock missing simplified-segment controls

After a trace loads on 390px, Step, Candidate, and Play are on the bottom bar, but previous / next simplified segment exists only as desktop Shift+arrows.

Problem: no Segment control on the phone dock

Instructions

Step ← / →Previous / next step on the bottom bar
Candidate ‹ / ›Previous / next candidate
PlayPlay / pause auto-advance
DragPan the view
PinchZoom in / out
Hide / ControlsHide or show Status and layers
←Step ‹Candidate ▶Play ›Candidate →Step

The dock can step and cycle candidates, but there is no touch control matching desktop Shift+arrows for simplified segments.

Fix: add a Segment row and name it in Instructions

Instructions

Step ← / →Previous / next step on the bottom bar
Segment « / »Previous / next simplified segment
Candidate ‹ / ›Previous / next candidate
PlayPlay / pause auto-advance
DragPan the view
PinchZoom in / out
Hide / ControlsHide or show Status and layers
←Step ‹Candidate ▶Play ›Candidate →Step «Segment »Segment

The 390px dock now has Segment « / » under Step / Candidate / Play. Instructions name that control. Desktop still uses Shift+arrows on the playback bar.

**Fix:** At max-width 720px the card describes the dock buttons and touch gestures (Step, Candidate, Play, drag, pinch, Hide / Controls). Desktop (`min-width: 721px`) still shows the keyboard shortcut table.

**Evidence:**

- Mobile live Instructions (390px): `web/usability/mobile-instructions-shortcuts-live.png`
- Before/after markup fixture: `web/usability/mobile-instructions-shortcuts.html`
- Fixture screenshot: `web/usability/mobile-instructions-shortcuts.png`

### Mobile dock had no simplified-segment control

**Where:** 390px loaded-trace screen, `#mobileTransport` after `body.trace-loaded-mobile.playback-ready`.

**Problem:** Desktop can jump previous / next simplified segment with Shift+arrows and the playback-bar prefix buttons. The phone dock only had Step, Candidate, and Play, so that jump had no touch equivalent.

**Fix:** The dock keeps the five existing controls on the first row and adds Segment « / » on a second row (half-width each, so labels stay readable at 390px). Those buttons click the same prefix controls as desktop. Sidebar padding and the closed-panel Controls offset grew with the taller dock. The mobile Instructions table now names Segment.

**Evidence:**

- Mobile live playback-ready dock (390px): `web/usability/mobile-dock-segment-live.png`
- Mobile live Instructions (390px): `web/usability/mobile-dock-segment-instructions-live.png`
- Before/after markup fixture: `web/usability/mobile-dock-segment.html`
- Fixture screenshot: `web/usability/mobile-dock-segment.png`

content.text: {"success":true,"summary":"Added previous/next simplified-segment controls to the 390px playback dock and documented them with live and before/after screenshot evidence.","key_changes_made":["The mobile dock keeps Step / Candidate / Play on the first row and adds Segment « / » on a second row, wired to the same prefix buttons as desktop Shift+arrows.","Sidebar and closed-panel dock clearance grew with the taller bar so Status, Instructions, and Controls stay above it; the mobile Instructions table now names Segment.","Captured 390px live dock and Instructions shots plus a before/after fixture, and logged the remaining missing mobile Play speed control."],"key_learnings":["Seven equal columns at 390px would clip Candidate; a 10-column grid with span-2 first-row buttons and span-5 Segment buttons keeps labels readable.","Dock height is 115px plus a 10px inset, so sidebar padding had to move from 88px to 148px and the closed-panel Controls offset from 76px to 136px.","scrollIntoView(block:end) photographs Instructions under the dock even when padding is enough; max scrollHeight is the check that last rows sit above dockTop.","Desktop speed presets live on #playbackBar, which stays display:none below 720px, so mobile Play is still locked at 1x."]}
